GROOVE CIRCUIT B5 PREVIEW - loads+plays and shows the GRV6 skin's Browse info block, same as the on-screen PREVIEW button (was LoadSelectedTrackAndPlay, normal)
B1 BROWSE - rotate - GRV6 skin Main tab: zoom all waveforms; otherwise scroll tracklist/tree view (was MoveVertical, selectknob)
B1 BROWSE +SHIFT - rotate - live library zoom (confirmed via aseqdump: a separate CC, not a shift flag on the plain rotate message)
D13/D15 DECK 1/3 and D14/D16 DECK 2/4 buttons: tells the GRV6 skin which deck each side controls (Deck 1 control on/off)
B1 BROWSE +SHIFT - press - Move cursor between track list and tree view
